Definition: Does the government maintain a separate cadastral register?
Comments: No credible evidence found after searching for Namibia cadastral information system; found references to DSM Digital Cadastral Information System project (ArcCadastre) suggesting development but no clear deployment status year.
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Confirmed with sources not previously cited. Namibia's Directorate of Survey and Mapping (DSM) maintains a cadastral system separate from the Deeds Office land/title register, built from a Swedesurvey-led Digital Cadastral Information System (ArcCadastre/geodatabase). A 2023 FIG conference paper (Mabakeng) reports the system 'crashed last year and is currently under further development', and a 2019 Aalborg University land governance paper confirms the cadastre is 'undergoing digitisation of data and maps' with both digital and analogue records still kept in parallel, i.e. not yet fully deployed. This corroborates Value Code 3 (Under development); code unchanged and confirmed on two independent academic/professional sources, resolving the prior no-source and no-year flags.
